meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I have no idea at all.

встать.gloss: to stand up, to get up

meanings.en: to stand up, to get up (out of bed)

examples.text: Кто первый встал, того и тапки.
examples.trans: First come, first served (whoever got up first gets the slippers).

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

выучить.gloss: to learn (by heart or thoroughly), to memorise

meanings.en: to learn thoroughly, to master, to memorise

examples.trans: I learned all the new words.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

examples.text: В детстве я жил в Москве.
examples.trans: As a child I lived in Moscow.

заболеть.gloss: to fall ill, to get sick

meanings.en: to fall ill, to come down with an illness

examples.text: Вчера он заболел и остался дома.
examples.trans: Yesterday he fell ill and stayed at home.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.en: chosen, elected (often used as a noun: мой избранный = my chosen one)

examples.text: Ты считай, Вань, как мой избранный.
examples.trans: Consider yourself, Vanya, like my chosen one.
He is the mayor elected by the people.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Vanya, let me give you some cabbage.
A leader has to be strong.

марш.gloss: march! (military command: шагом марш! = forward march!)

examples.text: Встала и мыть посуду, шагом марш!
examples.trans: Get up and wash the dishes, forward march!
Off to sleep quickly, march to bed!

examples.text: У меня учительница по математике заболела.
Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: You are wrong in this argument.

examples.text: Такие люди должны лежать в особенном месте!
examples.trans: Such people should lie in a special place!
Today is a special day for us.

отложить.gloss: to put aside, to put down; to postpone

meanings.en: to put aside, to lay down

examples.trans: We postponed the meeting until tomorrow.

очищать.gloss: to clean, to clear, to cleanse

meanings.en: to clean, to clear, to rid of

examples.trans: Dad is cleaning the city of criminals!
Trucks are clearing the streets of snow.

meanings.note: declines like a feminine noun in -а, but is masculine
as a conjunction: пока я сплю

meanings.en: dishes, plates and cups, tableware (collective singular)
meanings.note: мыть посуду = to wash the dishes

examples.trans: Get up and go wash the dishes!
Clean tableware is on the table.
Why are we going so slowly?
Dad is cleaning the city of criminals!

meanings.en: to talk, to speak, to have a conversation

examples.trans: Why are you talking so rudely?

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: Why are you sitting in the corner?

считать.gloss: to count; to think, to consider

meanings.note: я считаю, что... = I think that...

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

тыкать.gloss: to poke, to jab, to tap

meanings.en: to poke, to prod, to tap at (a screen or button)

examples.text: Что ты в телефон свой тычешь?
examples.trans: Why are you poking at your phone?

examples.text: А у меня учительница по математике заболела.

учиться.gloss: to study, to be a student; to learn

meanings.en: to study, to be a student
to learn how to do something

examples.text: Но вы же с ним учились вместе!
examples.trans: But you studied together with him!
There are a lot of people here.

шагом.gloss: at a walk, marching pace (шагом марш! = forward march!)

meanings.en: at a walk, step by step (military command шагом марш! = forward march!)

examples.text: Встала и мыть посуду, шагом марш!
examples.trans: Get up and wash the dishes, forward march!
We walked at a brisk pace.
The children are going to school.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
